risks.risk: The bike may have mechanical issues such as a broken chain, gear failure, or a seized rear derailleur.
risks.proof: A video of the bike being pedaled through a full gear range.

risks.risk: The tires may be worn or have low tread depth.
risks.proof: A photo of the tread on the bottom of the tires.

risks.risk: The frame may have hidden rust or structural damage.
risks.proof: A photo of the frame from the underside and a close-up of the welds.

proof_requests: Video of the bike being ridden or pedaled to check the drivetrain.
Close-up photo of the bottom of the tires to check tread depth.
Photo of the underside of the frame to check for rust or damage.
Photo of the gear shifter and derailleur to check for wear.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
